fields.features_heading: What an Event Booking Form Checks First
fields.features_subheading: An event booking form takes the date, the guest count, and the event type, then checks each one against what you can host.
fields.feature_1:
Rooms that fit the guest count

Give each room its seated limit, and the form offers only rooms that hold the party. A request for 90 guests never sees the 40-seat room, and the count is saved with it.
fields.feature_2:
One event per room on each date

Every confirmed booking blocks its room for that date. When someone picks a Saturday that is taken, the form marks it booked and lists the next open dates for the same room.
fields.feature_3:
Packages priced per guest

Price catering per guest and chair rental per item. The form multiplies each package by the guest count and shows the full total before the client sends the booking.
fields.feature_4:
Holds that end on a schedule

Hold a requested date for as many days as you choose. If nobody marks a deposit received by the last day, the app releases the date and emails the next person waiting on it.
fields.feature_5:
Each booking sent to whoever runs it

Email weddings to the coordinator and post corporate events to a Slack channel. Each alert carries the date, room, and guest count, and the booking stays in a database you own.
fields.feature_6:
Export the code when you need to

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository and host the booking form on your own servers, next to the calendar or ticketing system you already run.

fields.usecase_heading: Where an Event Booking Form Works
fields.tab_content_1:
The Gallery disappears for any party over 60

Ironbridge Loft rents two rooms: the Gallery seats 60 and Foundry Hall seats 180. Ambrosine Quandt asks for Saturday, September 19 for a retirement party of 140 guests, and the form offers Foundry Hall alone. Rosalind Ebbe, the events manager, gets each booking by email.
fields.tab_content_2:
No tents left on June 6 once Wynstan books

Bluestem Party Rentals owns 4 frame tents, and 3 of the 4 were already booked for Saturday, June 6. Wynstan Odegaard books the last one for a graduation party, with his delivery address and a 9:00 a.m. setup time. The next customer who picks that date sees tents marked booked out.
fields.tab_content_3:
Setup sheet to Crispin, 3 days before the event

Wren Dellacroce books Copperbeech Conference Center for Thursday, October 15, in a banquet setup for 90 guests. She adds a projector and 2 wireless mics. On Monday, October 12, operations lead Crispin Hallworth gets the setup sheet by email, with the seating, the equipment, and her phone number.
fields.tab_content_4:
After 7 days with no deposit, October 3 reopens

Every inquiry at Juniper Barn holds its date for 7 days. On May 4 the Merriwether wedding placed a hold on Saturday, October 3. By May 11 nobody had marked a deposit received. The app released the date and emailed Elias and Mara Tamsett, next in line for October 3.

fields.howto_title: How to Create an Event Booking Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create an event booking form that checks each date and room before it saves a booking, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Count what you can host on one date
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Ask for the date before anything else
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Decide how long a date stays held
fields.howto_step_1_des: List every room or rental item you book, with its limit: seats or units per date. A loft with two rooms has two limits on each date, and a rental company has one for each item it owns.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Put the event date first, then how many guests are coming and what kind of event it is. Those three answers decide which rooms or items the form can offer, and every later question shows only the options still open.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write each catering or equipment price as a rate per guest or per item. Set a minimum wherever you need one, such as a 50-guest floor on the plated dinner, and say what the form shows when a party falls short.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Pick a hold length you will enforce, such as 7 days, and the one thing that ends it early: a deposit marked received. Decide who hears when a hold lapses, and whether the next inquiry for that date gets an email.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Write one prompt that lists each room with its seats, each package with its price, and how long a hold lasts. Emergent builds the form and the bookings table behind it. To change a price later, say so in plain English.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Send each booking to its owner
fields.howto_step_6_des: Choose who gets each kind of booking, such as weddings to the venue coordinator and corporate events to operations. Add a timed email as well, such as a reminder to the client one week before the event.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Book a test event on a date you know is taken, then one with more guests than your smallest room seats. Check that the form refuses the first, offers only the larger room on the second, and saves both requests in the table.

faq_plan.q: What is an event booking form?
faq_plan.a: An event booking form is the online form a venue, rental company, or event business uses to take bookings for a date. It collects the event date, the guest count, the event type, and the client's contact details, then saves the booking for staff to confirm.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an event booking form?
faq_plan.a: List what you book and its limits, the questions you need answered, and who receives each booking. Describe all of it in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder. It builds the form and a database of bookings, and you change either one by prompting again.

faq_plan.q: What should an event booking form template include?
faq_plan.a: Start with the date, the number of guests, the kind of event, and a contact name, email, and phone number. Add the room or item being booked, any packages, and the deposit status. If you began from an event booking form PDF, keep its questions and describe them in a sentence: Emergent builds the online version, with no cap on how many bookings it takes.

faq_plan.q: When do I need an event booking form instead of a general one?
faq_plan.a: You need one when the booking depends on the date and the size of the party. A booking form for appointments needs only an open time slot. An event booking form also checks how many guests a room seats, prices packages per guest, and holds a date while the client decides.

faq_plan.q: How do I take a deposit on an event booking form?
faq_plan.a: Connect the payment tool you already use. Apps built with Emergent connect to any tool with an API and sync data in and out, so the deposit status sits on the same row as the booking. If clients pay by check, add a field staff mark when it arrives.

faq_plan.q: How do I stop an event booking form from taking two events on one date?
faq_plan.a: Give each room or item a limit per date, and have the form count confirmed bookings before it offers that date. Count active holds as well, so a date held for one client stays off the form until the hold ends or the deposit arrives.

faq_plan.q: Can an event booking form also reserve guest rooms for attendees?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Add a question asking how many guests need rooms and for which nights, and send those answers to the hotel contact by email. For a room block with its own rates and cutoff date, a separate hotel booking form keeps those requests apart from the event.

faq_plan.q: Should an event booking form ask for an exact guest count?
faq_plan.a: Ask for an estimate when the client books and a final number by a set date, such as 14 days before the event. Rooms and per-guest prices depend on that number. Add a field staff update when the final count arrives, and have the app email the client a reminder before the deadline.

faq_plan.q: How long should a venue hold a date on an event booking form?
faq_plan.a: Long enough for a client to decide, and short enough that a popular Saturday is not tied up for weeks. Pick a number such as 7 days and print it on the form, next to the date picker. Each hold and its deposit status stay on record in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Should an event booking form ask which outside vendors are coming?
faq_plan.a: Yes, when vendors need a load-in time or floor space. Ask each vendor for a company name and an arrival time, and copy those answers onto the setup sheet. A DJ who takes gigs directly works from a different form: a DJ booking form asks the client for the set length and the music.
